warning a11y_click_events_have_key_events 7:2-7:36 Visible, non-interactive element `<div>` with a click event must be accompanied by a keyboard event handler. Consider whether an interactive element such as `<button type="button">` or `<a>` might be more appropriate

warning event_directive_deprecated 7:18-7:26 Using `on:click` to listen to the click event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onclick` instead
    https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated
